verification: CI unit fixtures: two generated compose projects (personal and swarm) rendered into temporary config roots; docker host view and compose invocations faked at the agentibrain.bootstrap seam. Mocked: no docker daemon or deployed brain was contacted.
assertions: With conflicting ports, starting swarm exits 1 and lists each port with the personal container holding it; no compose command runs and no stack is removed.
The bearer never appears in the refusal output.
The protected host view (published ports) is unchanged by the refused request.
A second config root using the same brain id is refused as a project conflict; a shared vault is refused as a volume conflict.
A brain whose id extends another (a and a-b) does not treat the other's containers as its own.
After the refusal, starting swarm again with corrected ports is a new request that succeeds and touches only swarm.
